edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Excess pulsatile stress may damage delicate cerebral microvasculature, providing one vascular pathway from high pulse pressure to dementia.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2026 Zhao meta analysis in Front Neurol, which ties high pulse pressure to dementia (all-cause) in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
